items.title: AI agents are going rogue. CIOs are racing to put guardrails around them
items.summary: As AI agents take on more work—and present new risks—Cisco, Intuit, Workday, and ServiceNow are creating layers of oversight to monitor, govern, and contain them.
items.titleZh: 人工智能代理正在变得无赖。首席信息官们正争先恐后地在他们周围设置护栏
items.summaryZh: 随着人工智能代理承担更多的工作并带来新的风险，思科、Intuit、Workday和ServiceNow正在创建监督层来监控、管理和遏制它们。

items.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
items.summary: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.
items.titleZh: 扎克伯格反对人工智能协同减速，称实验室可以单独行动
items.summaryZh: Meta的首席执行官表示，竞争和潜在的责任使人工智能开发人员有理由优先考虑安全，并引用了该公司推迟Muse的决定。

items.title: Goldman says the economy is rewarding capital ownership over labor — and most Americans don’t own enough of it to benefit
items.summary: The labor share of income has fallen to a record low, the lowest in 80 years. What is going on here, exactly?

items.summaryZh: 劳动收入占总收入的比例已降至80年来的最低水平。这里到底发生了什么？
